description: Source code for a Jira importer module in a project, handling XML parsing, board and card creation, and data transformation for a task management system.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main function to read an input XML file, parse Jira issues, convert them into board and card structures, and save the archive.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts Jira items into board and block structures, creating properties and mapping issue fields.

methods.name: buildCardPropertyFromValues
methods.description: Creates a property template with options based on unique values from Jira issue fields.

methods.name: setSelectProperty
methods.description: Assigns a select property value to a card based on a property option.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a property value directly on a card.

methods.name: optionForPropertyValue
methods.description: Finds the property option matching a given value.
